apps.name: geodaddy
apps.subtitle: GEO analysis tool for AI-powered search optimization
apps.description: Analyze any website for Generative Engine Optimization — surface actionable issues to rank in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
apps.longDescription: geodaddy is an open source CLI tool for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). It crawls any URL — including localhost — and produces a structured JSON report with scores across four categories: Technical SEO, Content Structure, GEO-specific signals, and Core Web Vitals. Each issue comes with a specific, actionable fix recommendation. Built in Rust for speed and distributed as a single binary with no runtime dependencies. Perfect for CI/CD pipelines, local dev testing, and automated GEO audits.
apps.requirements: macOS, Linux, or Windows (x86_64 / ARM64). No runtime dependencies.
features: Technical SEO analysis: meta tags, headings, HTTPS, mobile viewport, robots.txt, sitemap
GEO-specific checks: AI bot access audit (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Perplexity), Schema.org triple stacking, listicle detection
Content structure scoring: heading hierarchy, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, alt text
Core Web Vitals measurement via headless browser (--vitals flag)
Site-wide crawling with sitemap-first strategy (--max-pages flag)
Optional JavaScript rendering for SPAs (--enable-js flag)
Structured JSON output — machine-readable, no runtime dependencies
Runs completely locally — no API keys, no cloud dependencies
